raw:
These probabilities come from my prior knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 behavior, not from querying the benchmark data. The main heuristics are:

- Edge 3 (0->3) and edge 5 (2->3) are direct paths to the output. Edits there matter more when the other paths are weak.
- Conv edits help less when a conv already sits on a parallel path, and more when the cell is otherwise poor.
- An edit that does not change the op (condition says the parent already has that op) is not a meaningful comparison, so I scored those mostly N.
